# genesis-vibes

Shared crate for cross-cutting CLI/AIX/self-healing infrastructure.

## Quick start

- [Repository](https://github.com/charly-vibes/genesis)
- [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/genesis-vibes)
- [Documentation](https://charly-vibes.github.io/genesis/)
- [Getting Started](https://charly-vibes.github.io/genesis/getting-started.html)
- [How-to Guides](https://charly-vibes.github.io/genesis/)
- [Modules Reference](https://charly-vibes.github.io/genesis/reference/modules.html)

## Modules

- `envelope` — structured CLI output envelope
- `suggestions` — self-healing error suggestions
- `managed_block` — managed block injector
- `aix` — AIX artifact generation
- `config` — shared config management
- `guide` — CLI scaffold (Verbosity, CliVerbosity, OutputFormat, CliFormat, Output, Guide). Format auto-detect: JSON for non-TTY stdout (agents/pipes), Human for terminals.
- `fixture` — test scratch environments
- `feedback` — agent issue reporting
- `suite_linter` — suite-wide lint checks
- `doctor` — diagnostics with auto-fix
- `cli` — CLI helpers
- `status` — cross-tool status dashboard
- `scaffold` — init scaffolding
- `discovery` — tool discovery via .genesis/tools.toml manifest
